source_claim: Shogakukan's official page for Karakai Jouzu (?) no Nishikata-san identifies Nishikata Chi as the daughter of Nishikata and (former) Takagi-san, says the story is set seven years after Moto Takagi-san, and describes the book as another story in the Takagi-san series. This establishes Chi as a character in the same canonical Takagi-san franchise.
notes: The publisher's source explicitly identifies parentage and places the spin-off in the Takagi-san series; the canonical HOME is the main franchise work.
